        if seg["capacity"] < seg["minimum"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Segment '{seg['name']}' capacity < minimum")

    min_sum = sum(seg["minimum"] for seg in segments)
    cap_sum = sum(seg["capacity"] for seg in segments)

    if budget < min_sum:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Budget {budget} is below minimum quota sum {min_sum}"
        )
    if budget > cap_sum:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Budget {budget} exceeds total capacity {cap_sum}"
        )

    # Initialize every segment at its minimum quota
    allocations = [seg["minimum"] for seg in segments]
    remaining = budget - min_sum

    # Greedy allocation: give one token to the segment maximizing
    # importance / (current_allocation + 1); tie-break by original order
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_score = None

        for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
            if allocations[i] >= seg["capacity"]:
                continue
            score = seg["importance"] / (allocations[i] + 1)
            if best_score is None or score > best_score:
